newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan blue-chip index up 22.26 pct this year.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan blue-chip index up 22.26 pct this year.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange's blue chip index shot up in the week to Friday, taking its rise in 1997 to 22.26 percent, its market report shows.
The 12-VB blue-chip index this week rose 2.48 percent to 295.86, boosted by a rise in shares of bank BICICI and tobacco company SITAB.
The All-Share Index rose 0.46 percent to 420.85, taking its 1997 rise to 17.62 percent.
A total of 3,011 shares worth 76,649,440 CFA francs were traded, compared with 4,909 shares worth of 111,099,846 CFA francs the previous week.

The main risers were BICICI (+2,730 to 40,950), SITAB (+2,330 to 49,050) and car finance company SAFCA (1,150 to 23,700). Water utility SODECI (+890 to 20,890) accounted for 28.96 percent of the total volume.
The main decliners were rubber company SOGB (-2,820 to 16,460), bank SGBCI (-940 to 17,210) and cement manufacturer SICM (-900 to 33,700).
